scenario: Legacy payment EOD restart/resume after durable internal or external financial effects.

root_cause_clusters.RC-IDENTITY: Replay identity and cycle provenance are conflated.
root_cause_clusters.RC-ELIGIBILITY: Debit capacity and account eligibility omit financial obligations or state.
root_cause_clusters.RC-RESUME: Durable posting/reservation state is treated as a request to execute again.
root_cause_clusters.RC-ACCOUNTING: Ledger/reconciliation controls validate aggregates too weakly or with wrong scope.
root_cause_clusters.RC-CLOSE: Publication and completion are advanced before their control prerequisites.
root_cause_clusters.RC-DB: Database boundaries do not enforce exactly-once financial state.

defects.observable_failure: Commercially similar prior history can be reported as an accepted source replay.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing PAYDUP alone is insufficient because the shell can still set source_seen from commercial similarity.

defects.observable_failure: History written by the current cycle can be treated as prior replay evidence on a rerun.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A source-only query still misclassifies restart work unless cycle provenance is excluded.

defects.observable_failure: PAYDUP classifies commercial similarity as DUPLICATE.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Correct history flags still fail if the COBOL decision merges similarity with identity.

defects.observable_failure: Blocked internal beneficiaries are treated as eligible.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A shell-only status check does not repair the documented COBOL decision interface.

defects.observable_failure: Total debit omits fee and tax.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Correct capacity subtraction still approves payments when the requested debit is understated.

defects.observable_failure: PAYCAP ignores reserved debit when calculating available capacity.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A correct SQL reservation sum is ineffective if the decision program ignores it.

defects.observable_failure: Existing internal postings are routed to POST_INTERNAL again.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Database uniqueness can stop a duplicate row but cannot by itself preserve restart progress or balances.

defects.observable_failure: Existing external reservations are routed to RESERVE_EXTERNAL again.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing clearing alone still permits a second reservation.

defects.observable_failure: A resumed reservation is accepted even when its durable debit is inconsistent.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Resume routing is unsafe without validating the authoritative amount.

defects.observable_failure: Existing clearing is always recreated instead of retained.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reservation idempotency alone does not prevent duplicate clearing.

defects.observable_failure: Equal-or-greater debit is accepted and expected ledger row count is ignored.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Aggregate balance can look acceptable while an obligation is missing.

defects.observable_failure: Reconciliation effectively reduces the whole close control to a weak ledger comparison.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing one SQL metric does not restore population, financial-effect, reservation and ledger invariants.

defects.observable_failure: Close ignores report and archive completion.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A balanced cycle can be authorized before operational close work is done.

defects.observable_failure: Publication is allowed for HELD reconciliation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Close gating does not prevent stale official response/clearing files from escaping earlier.

defects.observable_failure: Any balanced cycle is labeled completed even when close is waiting.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Correct reconciliation is not equivalent to completion.

defects.observable_failure: Reservation capacity query is global, includes wrong payers/inactive rows, and does not exclude the payment being resumed.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Repairing PAYCAP without the authoritative reservation population still computes wrong capacity.

defects.observable_failure: Internal resume ledger reconstruction omits TAX_PAYABLE.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Balances remain unchanged but reconciliation still becomes incomplete.

defects.observable_failure: External resume ledger reconstruction omits TAX_PAYABLE.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reservation/clearing can look correct while accounting is incomplete.

defects.observable_failure: Internal beneficiary credit update does not require an active beneficiary.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Even if eligibility is fixed elsewhere, this removes the transaction-layer safety boundary.

defects.observable_failure: Reservation, clearing and ledger totals include other cycles.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A perfectly repaired payment path can still hold or balance incorrectly because the gate is not cycle scoped.

defects.observable_failure: Invalid effects on DUPLICATE/REJECTED outcomes are forced to zero.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Duplicate suppression bugs can be hidden from reconciliation.

defects.observable_failure: Durable posting/reservation/clearing mismatches are forced to zero.
defects.partial_fix_trap: An inconsistent resume can be published as balanced.

defects.observable_failure: Missing successful-payment ledger obligations are forced to zero.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Ledger reconstruction defects are masked by the final gate.

defects.observable_failure: Multiple internal postings can exist for one payment.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Routing fixes lack a database last line of defense against replay races/retries.

defects.observable_failure: Multiple active reservations can exist for one payment.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A second reservation survives if orchestration retries at the wrong point.

defects.observable_failure: Multiple clearing items can exist for one payment.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Application-level KEEP logic is insufficient under repeated execution.

defects.observable_failure: Duplicate ledger obligations for the same payment/side/account code are allowed.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Resume reconstruction can multiply accounting state.

defects.observable_failure: Multiple success authorizations can be stored for one cycle.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Repeated close can emit more than one downstream authorization.

defects.observable_failure: Clearing/completion/authorization transitions are not guarded by reservation/reconciliation/completion state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing uniqueness does not enforce ordering between financial and close phases.

anti_padding_attestation: All counted application libraries are sourced or called by the batch runtime; tests, solution and docs are excluded from the LOC floor.
